corrections.old_text: ይጻፍዐከ ፡ በመቅሠፍተ፡ መዓቱ፡ ኦ፡ ነኪር ፡ ዘትመ↵
corrections.corrected_text: ይጽፍዐከ ፡ በመቅሠፍተ፡ መዓቱ፡ ኦ፡ ነኪር ፡ ዘትመ
corrections.reason: Both visually on the page (matching ይጽፍዕዎ in L14 with the 6th-order bent left leg of ጽ) and morphologically in Classical Ge'ez (subjunctive ይጽፋዕ + 2ms object suffix -ከ -> ይጽፍዐከ, Acts 23:3), the character is ጽ, not ጻ.
